jobs.title: Corporate Vice President, Product Ownership and Agile Delivery Leadership
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 94007

Location Designation:  Hybrid - 3 days per week

Role Overview

The Corporate Vice President – Product Owner will support the design, development, and evolution of the enterprise Insight & Analytics ecosystem , with a primary focus on advancing the dashboard strategy and user experience across agent, field manager, and home office audiences. This role is responsible for enabling data-driven decision-making by delivering scalable, intuitive, and high-impact analytics products that unify data, surface actionable insights, and improve business performance.

In this strategic role, the Product Owner will translate the Product Manager’s multi-year vision for the analytics and dashboard ecosystem into actionable work for agile delivery teams. This includes ownership of the product backlog, ensuring alignment to business priorities and data strategy, and delivering high-quality, insight-driven capabilities using the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

The role requires a strong blend of data fluency, product ownership discipline, and user-centric thinking , along with the ability to partner across data engineering, BI, UX, and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful, measurable outcomes.

What You'll Bring

Product Leadership

- Proven experience leading complex digital, data, and analytics products from concept through delivery and adoption.

- Demonstrated ability to align product priorities with business strategy, customer needs, and measurable outcomes.

- Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to build alignment across business, technology, data, and operations teams.

- Experience defining product vision, success metrics, roadmaps, and value realization strategies.

- Ability to drive product adoption, change management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Technology, Data & AI Knowledge

- Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems, including data warehousing, data modeling, semantic layers, data governance, and data quality management.

- Experience partnering with Data Engineering, Analytics, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable data products and analytical solutions.

- Proficiency with Business Intelligence and visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar technologies.

- Deep understanding of KPI development, metric standardization, reporting frameworks, and analytical best practices.

- Knowledge of modern AI and Generative AI capabilities, including practical applications for analytics, insights generation, personalization, automation, and decision support.

- Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data architectures preferred (Azure, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, etc.).

- Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into actionable business value and user-focused solutions.

Agile Product Ownership & Delivery Excellence

- Agile/Product Owner certification (SAFe PO/PM, Certified Scrum Product Owner, or equivalent) preferred.

- Strong experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs in Agile and SAFe environments.

- Expertise in user story creation, acceptance criteria development, backlog refinement, and feature prioritization.

- Experience leading PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Iteration Reviews, System Demos, and Retrospectives.

- Proven ability to identify and manage dependencies, risks, and delivery trade-offs across multiple teams.

- Strong understanding of user research, customer insights, journey mapping, and requirements elicitation techniques.

- Experience driving organizational change management, user adoption, and business readiness activities for new capabilities and products.

Digital Product Management Experience

- 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related roles supporting digital, analytics, or data-driven products.

- Experience delivering enterprise-scale dashboards, self-service analytics platforms, reporting solutions, or digital experiences.

- Proven track record of leveraging user insights, customer feedback, and analytics to inform product decisions and roadmap priorities.

- Experience defining and tracking product KPIs, adoption metrics, engagement measures, and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated success delivering products in highly regulated environments, with financial services or insurance experience preferred.

- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Business, Data Analytics, Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.

Preferred Analytics & Data Product Expertise

- Experience managing data products, analytical platforms, or enterprise reporting ecosystems.

- Understanding of data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data lineage concepts.

- Experience with data discovery, self-service analytics, and business intelligence enablement.

- Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and data-driven decision frameworks.

- Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory, and compliance considerations within analytics environments.

What You’ll Bring

- Proven experience leading digital, data, analytics, or insight-driven products, translating business strategy into measurable outcomes and scalable product solutions.

- Strong product leadership skills with the ability to influence stakeholders, drive prioritization decisions, and align business, technology, data, and user needs across complex organizations.

- Deep knowledge of data and analytics, including KPI development, data modeling, data governance, reporting frameworks, business intelligence, and enterprise data ecosystems.

- Experience working with analytics and visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, and modern cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake).

- Understanding of AI and Generative AI capabilities and their practical application to analytics, insights generation, automation, personalization, and decision support.

- Demonstrated expertise as a Product Owner in Agile and SAFe environments, including user research, backlog creation and management, user story development, PI Planning, Sprint Planning, execution, and release management.

- Proven ability to drive change management, user adoption, business readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives while delivering intuitive, user-centered digital experiences.

- Bachelor's degree required with 7+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Product Delivery, Data Products, Analytics, or related disciplines; financial services and/or insurance industry experience preferred, with Agile/Product Owner certifications considered a plus.

Key Competencies

- Product Leadership & Strategic Thinking

- Data, Analytics & AI Fluency

- Agile Product Ownership & Delivery Excellence

- User-Centered Design & Customer Advocacy

- Digital Product Management Expertise

- Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Change Leadership & Adoption Management

- Communication, Influence & Executive Presence

Pay Transparency

Sales bonus eligible: No

jobs.title: Corporate Vice President, Product Solutions Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 95065

Location Designation:  Hybrid - 3 days per week

Role Overview:

New York Life is seeking a dynamic and experienced marketer to shape and drive go-to-market strategies for its Protection Solutions portfolio, including Life Insurance, Individual Disability Insurance, and Long-Term Care Insurance. This role will serve as a senior strategic marketing partner to the protection lines of business, responsible for translating business, product, and distribution priorities into integrated marketing strategies that strengthen New York Life's position in the market, support our sales force, deepen consumer engagement, and drive business growth.

This individual will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies across the protection portfolio, including product positioning and value propositions, targeted campaigns, consumer-facing marketing collateral, product launches, and sales enablement programs. This role requires a strong ability to understand complex financial and insurance products and translate them into clear, compelling marketing strategies and messages that resonate with consumers and enable effective sales conversations.

The Product Solutions Senior Marketing Manager will serve as a strategic marketing partner with both the product development and sales teams, bringing marketing expertise, consumer and market insights, and a strong point of view on how New York Life can most effectively bring its protection solutions to market.

The ideal candidate brings significant financial services marketing experience, with life insurance or broader protection-product marketing experience strongly preferred, as well as demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies in a complex, highly regulated organization.

This is a dynamic role for an experienced marketer who combines strategic thinking with the ability to drive hands-on execution, operates with a high degree of independence and ownership, and is skilled at influencing and aligning stakeholders across a complex organization.

What You'll Do:

· Lead the development and execution of comprehensive go-to-market strategies across New York Life's Protection Solutions portfolio, including Life Insurance, Individual Disability Insurance, and Long-Term Care Insurance.

· Serve as a senior strategic marketing partner and thought partner to Protection Solutions leadership, product teams, and sales and distribution partners, bringing a

strong marketing perspective to business priorities, growth opportunities, and go-to-market decisions.

· Translate business and product priorities into integrated marketing strategies and programs designed to increase awareness, engagement, consideration, and sales across New York Life's protection solutions.

· Develop compelling product positioning, messaging, value propositions, and consumer-facing collateral that simplify complex protection concepts, articulate New York Life's differentiated value, and help consumers understand how protection solutions address important financial needs.

· Develop and execute targeted, integrated marketing campaigns across appropriate channels and audience segments, leveraging consumer insights, financial needs, life events, and other relevant segmentation opportunities.

· Partner closely with product teams on new product launches, product enhancements, pricing or feature changes, and other key business initiatives, developing the marketing strategy and driving a coordinated approach from planning through market activation.

· Collaborate with sales and distribution partners to understand field needs and develop marketing programs, content, tools, and sales enablement strategies that help drive product adoption and support productive client conversations.

· Bring a strong consumer, market, and competitive perspective to the business, using consumer insights, category trends, competitive activity, and emerging marketing practices to identify opportunities and inform marketing recommendations.

· Partner across Marketing and with product, sales, distribution, digital, legal, compliance, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to drive initiatives from strategy through execution, ensuring programs are aligned to business priorities and effectively delivered.

· Establish clear objectives and measures of success for key marketing initiatives, using performance data and insights to optimize programs, inform future strategies, and demonstrate business impact.

What You'll Bring:

· 10+ years of marketing experience, with significant experience in financial services, insurance, or another complex and highly regulated industry.

· Experience in life insurance marketing strongly preferred; experience across life insurance, disability insurance, long-term care insurance, or other protection-oriented financial products is highly desirable.

· Demonstrated experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for financial products, including product launches, campaigns, positioning, messaging, and ongoing product marketing.

· Strong understanding of consumer marketing, with experience developing targeted campaigns, content, collateral, positioning, and value propositions that make complex products understandable, relevant, and compelling.

· Experience partnering closely with product management, sales, and distribution organizations, with a strong understanding of how marketing can support consumer engagement, sales effectiveness, and business growth.

· Proven ability to operate as a senior individual contributor, independently owning complex initiatives and building strong relationships with and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

· Strong strategic and analytical skills, with the ability to use consumer insights, market intelligence, competitive information, and performance data to inform marketing strategies and connect marketing activity to measurable business outcomes.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts and develop clear, compelling, audience-focused messaging.

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive work from strategy through execution with a high degree of independence, initiative, judgment, and accountability.

· Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, finance, or a related field. MBA preferred.

jobs.description:
Location Designation:  Hybrid - 3 days per week

Director, NYL.com Product Management, Institutional Audiences

Dept: Experience and Digital Marketing (EDM)

Location: Hybrid – 3 days in Home office, NYC (Tues, Wed, Thu)

For over 180 years, New York Life Insurance Company has helped people achieve financial security and peace of mind. As a Fortune 100 company and the largest mutual life insurer in the United States, we are now transforming how we deliver on that mission, building AI-enabled, next-generation digital experiences that redefine how we connect with the people and institutions we serve. This is a rare opportunity to shape that future from the inside.

Position Overview

NYL.com is evolving from a traditional corporate website into a structured, composable digital platform, an enterprise asset that serves as New York Life’s authoritative content origin and owned experience engine across human and AI-driven channels. As AI changes how information is discovered and consumed, dotcom’s role shifts from destination to origin, ensuring the company’s content authority and experience quality wherever audiences encounter New York Life. Enabled by a move to cloud-based headless architecture, the platform is being reconceived as a multi-audience, intent-driven system that delivers dynamically composed experiences, deepens interactive capabilities like interaction tools, calculators, and conversion pathways, and generates data signals that inform content strategy, personalization, and business decisions.

The Director of NYL.com Product Management for Institutional Audiences (e.g., institutional investors, non-NYL financial professionals, small businesses, employers, and plan sponsors) drives this evolution for the institutional segment, owning the product strategy, roadmap, and data-driven capabilities that serve. This role manages the unique complexity of compliance-sensitive, data-intensive digital experiences and works closely with peer roles responsible for consumer and corporate audiences to ensure cross-audience coherence. The Director partners with Content Strategy, Content Operations, AI Experience Product Management, Experience Design, and Technology.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

- Own the product roadmap for all institutional-facing NYL.com surfaces, aligned to enterprise growth and relationship objectives.

- Develop business cases and requirements for institutional experience initiatives, including redesigns, data display enhancements, and new structured content capabilities.

- Define acceptance criteria for institutional product work and own product-level acceptance for strategic initiatives.

- Establish and maintain standards for data accuracy, timeliness, and regulatory compliance across all financial product displays.

- Ensure institutional-facing surfaces are built for both human and AI consumption, with structured data, metadata, and schema optimized for AI search engines and AI-driven channels alongside direct visitors.

- Proactively apply AI tools to accelerate product management workflows including analytics, requirements development, data auditing, and testing.

Audience Experiences and Capabilities

- Accountable for the experience strategy and quality of NYL.com surfaces serving institutional investors, financial professionals (non-NYL agents), small businesses, employers, and plan sponsors

- Accountable for audience specific data-driven capabilities (e.g., financial product performance tables and data displays, data feeds and structured data integrations, and compliance-sensitive content display), institutional resource libraries and document repositories (e.g., prospectuses, fact sheets, regulatory filings), employer and plan sponsor informational experiences, small business solutions pages and lead flows, and gated/authenticated content access for credentialed investor content and plan sponsor resources.

- Partner with AI Experience Product Management on institutional-facing AI capabilities such as intelligent document search and dynamic performance reporting.

Cross-functional Coordination

- Coordinate with Product Owners on solutioning and to translate institutional product work into the engineering backlog and align on sprint planning and capacity.

- Partner with Authoring/Content Operations for product-driven (strategic and optimization) institutional work.

- Partner with Production/Account Management on triage and escalation for institutional stakeholder requests with product implications.

- Partner with UX/Design on design briefs, design review, and acceptance for institutional experiences.

- Partner with Content Strategy and Content Operations on institutional content modeling and structured content delivery.

- Manage stakeholder relationships with key stakeholders (e.g., Investments, Institutional Businesses, Group Benefits (employer-facing), Compliance/Legal) and related business units.

Governance and Operations

- Apply the work tiering framework within the institutional audience portfolio, ensuring consistent categorization and routing of work.

- Maintain institutional-specific analytics, performance benchmarks, and success metrics, with particular attention to data accuracy and compliance standards.

- Escalate cross-audience conflicts and shared resource tradeoffs to the Senior Director.

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in business, finance, technology, or a related field preferred.

Experience

- 10+ years of experience in digital product management, with emphasis on data-driven or compliance-sensitive web experiences.

- Experience managing financial data displays, structured data integrations, or institutional-grade digital content.

- Demonstrated understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for financial product information, including disclosures and performance reporting standards.

- Experience in financial services, asset management, insurance, or a similarly regulated industry preferred.

- Experience coordinating with separate UX/Design, engineering, content, and operations teams.

- Experience integrating AI into product management practices and building digital products for both human and AI consumption is a strong plus.

Skills

- Strong product management skills with attention to data integrity, regulatory precision, and institutional audience expectations.

- Working knowledge of data feed integrations, document management systems, analytics platforms, and structured data standards.

- Functional fluency in AI experience concepts sufficient to collaborate credibly with AI Experience Product Management and evaluate emerging capabilities.

- Proactive adopter of AI tools in professional practice; able to model AI-augmented ways of working and evaluate emerging AI capabilities with credibility.

- Strong stakeholder management skills across investment, compliance, and business unit partners.

- Ability to balance competing priorities within a complex, multi-audience platform environment.

jobs.description:

Location Designation:  Hybrid - 3 days per week
Product Owner – NYL360 AI Assistant
NYL360 · New York Life
Reporting to Raian Alam, VP & NYL360 Product Manager
Location Hybrid - 3 days/week, NYC HQ

Help lead one of New York Life's most visible transformation initiatives.

NYL360 is reimagining how New York Life works – investing in a multi-year transformation to modernize the client, advisor, field manager and home office employee experience, replacing fragmented systems and daily friction to improve ease of doing business. NYL360 is the unified digital ecosystem at the center of this effort - and AI is central to its next chapter, with an intelligent Assistant and Voice Avatar giving advisors a natural, conversational way to get things done.  It's ambitious, fast-moving, and highly visible at the executive level. We’re looking for a Product Owner who thrives on keeping high-stakes work running smoothly and isn't afraid to jump in wherever needed.

Why This Role Matters

We're seeking a Product Owner to own NYL360's AI Assistant and Voice Avatar capabilities - one of the program's most visible and strategic pillars - while serving as a cross-pod partner to fellow Product Owners across NYL360. You'll drive AI prototyping in partnership with Google and Obin, bridge our internal teams with Obin's design and engineering group, and help upskill the broader PO community on modern AI tools. This is a chance to shape how tens of thousands of advisors talk to and interact with NYL360 - not just click through it.

What You'll Do

Own the AI Assistant & Voice Avatar
• Set the vision and roadmap for the AI Assistant / Voice Avatar - translating advisor pain points into conversational use cases.
• Run point on building out and enhancing the Avatar and mobile app functions.
• Partner with engineering, conversation design, and UX to keep the experience natural and trustworthy.

Drive AI Innovation & Prototyping
• Triage and prototype new AI concepts with Google and Obin, connecting them to existing Assistant capabilities.
• Lead early-stage prototyping across pods to identify what's ready to scale.
• Serve as the bridge between our POs, our Design team, and Obin's design & engineering teams.

Support Peer POs Across NYL360
• Partner with fellow Product Owners across pods to align priorities, dependencies, and standards.
• Upskill POs on intermediate and advanced AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT.
• Represent the AI/Voice workstream in cross-pod planning to keep NYL360 cohesive.

Lead Roadmap & Backlog
• Turn NYL360 principles and field research into a prioritized roadmap and well-defined backlog.
• Tackle high-friction workflows like case tracking, service status, and meeting prep.
• Define acceptance criteria and success metrics with stakeholders.

Drive Delivery & Vendor Integration
• Lead end-to-end feature delivery with engineering, UX, and field advocates.
• Manage risks tied to legacy infrastructure and cross-platform integration.
• Partner with vendors, including Google and Obin, validating deliverables for quality and fit.

What You’ll Bring

• Experience modernizing complex workflows and simplifying high-friction digital experiences.
• Genuine interest or experience in conversational AI, voice interfaces, or intelligent assistants.
• Comfort with modern AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and the ability to teach others.
• Strong user research instincts and experience turning field insights into product strategy.
• Preferably, Product Owner/Manager experience in digital transformation - financial services a plus.
• Collaborative mindset: comfortable navigating ambiguity, building consensus, and helping peers succeed.

jobs.description:

About New York Life Investment Management

With over $800 billion in assets under management, NYLIM is a Pensions & Investments ' Top 30 Largest Money Manager and one of the largest global asset managers serving institutional, retail and insurance clients. NYLIM brings together the firm’s global investment teams under one unified brand, combining specialized expertise with the strength and stability of New York Life.

Our platform is built on disciplined active management, deep investment capabilities and a long-term partnership approach designed to deliver enduring value across market cycles and help clients navigate the next era of investing.

More powerful, together, we combine the agility of specialized investment teams with the scale and longevity of a leading mutual institution.

Through a collaborative and strategic environment, NYLIM Marketing partners across the organization to strengthen the firm's brand, support business growth, and drive awareness of its differentiated investment capabilities. This hybrid position is based in New York City with an in-office presence of three days per week.

The Product Marketer will support NYLIM's fixed income investment solutions across multiple product structures, such as mutual funds, ETFs, SMAs, and interval funds. The ideal candidate combines investment marketing experience with intellectual curiosity, strong project management skills, keen attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex investment concepts into compelling marketing content.

What You’ll Do:

- Manage product marketing initiatives supporting fixed income solutions — including core/core plus, high yield, floating rate, municipals, and other income-oriented strategies — across multiple product structures, such as ETFs, mutual funds, and SMAs.

- Develop and maintain product positioning, messaging, and marketing content—including thought leadership, presentations, podcasts, videos, webcasts, sales collateral, and digital content—to communicate investment capabilities and differentiated value propositions while ensuring consistency across channels.

- Manage monthly and quarterly product marketing updates by proactively reviewing and refreshing positioning and messaging to ensure competitive differentiation and consistency across all materials and channels.

- Support product launches and strategic marketing campaigns designed to increase awareness and consideration of NYLIM investment solutions.

- Collaborate with investment boutiques and subject matter experts to translate market insights into client-focused marketing materials, with an emphasis on fixed income market themes, municipal investing, income solutions, and portfolio construction.

- Analyze industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to recommend enhancements to product messaging and marketing strategies.

- Serve as a key contributor on cross-functional initiatives and marketing projects to improve processes, streamline workflows, and enhance team effectiveness.

- Exercise sound judgment and independent decision-making while balancing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

What You’ll Bring:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Finance, Economics, Communications, or a related field.

- 3+ years of product marketing or financial services experience; fixed income experience preferred.

- Knowledge of fixed income markets, investment strategies, and products (e.g., ETFs, SMAs, mutual funds, interval funds).

- Ability to simplify complex investment concepts into compelling marketing content.

- Strong analytical, organizational, project management, and communication skills.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.

- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly PowerPoint; experience with SharePoint, Seismic, or similar platforms preferred.

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-sized and large companies. This position will support the execution of the established Group Benefit Solutions (GBS) product vision and multi-year roadmap across Life, Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D), Long-Term Care (LTC), Voluntary Benefits (VB), and future product offerings. The role will translate established product direction into product plans and lead the execution of key initiatives supporting the roadmap while partnering across cross-functional teams, internal stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver product solutions that drive profitable growth, product performance, and an enhanced customer experience.

The ideal candidate will possess broad knowledge of the Group Benefits market, including Life, AD&D, Long-Term Care, and Voluntary Benefits, with demonstrated experience translating product strategies into executable plans, leading complex initiatives, working cross-functionally, leveraging data and market intelligence, and building capabilities that improve competitiveness, operational outcomes, and customer experience.

What You’ll Do:

· Develop and manage assigned product initiatives, serving as the product single point of contact and owning execution of end-to-end product processes and outcomes.

Develop the strategy for execution and lead cross-functional project teams to deliver initiatives end-to-end throughout the product lifecycle, with a focus on implementation, competitive positioning, and operational excellence.

· Broad knowledge across group insurance products.

· Proven track record of developing strong relationships across matrix partners, Distribution, Operations, Technology, and external vendors.

· Demonstrated ability to identify strategic opportunities, lead complex initiatives with minimal direction, and develop recommendations, business cases, and options for senior leadership decision-making.

· Ability to develop innovative product recommendations and execution approaches that balance customer needs, competitive positioning, operational capabilities, and financial objectives.

· Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

· Self-directed with an entrepreneurial mindset and strong personal accountability.

About New York Life Investment Management

With over $800 billion in assets under management, NYLIM is a Pensions & Investments ' Top 30 Largest Money Manager and one of the largest global asset managers serving institutional, retail and insurance clients. NYLIM brings together the firm’s global investment teams under one unified brand, combining specialized expertise with the strength and stability of New York Life.

Our platform is built on disciplined active management, deep investment capabilities and a long-term partnership approach designed to deliver enduring value across market cycles and help clients navigate the next era of investing.

More powerful, together, we combine the agility of specialized investment teams with the scale and longevity of a leading mutual institution.

Through a collaborative and strategic environment, NYLIM Marketing partners across the organization to strengthen the firm's brand, support business growth, and drive awareness of its differentiated investment capabilities. This hybrid position is based in New York City with an in-office presence of three days per week.

What You’ll Do:

- Lead the development, enhancement, and ongoing maintenance of proactive product marketing for private market strategies, including content across formats such as tear sheets/fact cards, presentations, brochures, thought leadership, blogs, videos, and webinars, as well as digital campaigns in partnership with the institutional and retail segment marketing teams.

- Partner closely with the private market investment teams and Client Portfolio Managers, as well as with distribution, digital marketing, segment marketing, business intelligence, and compliance to craft compelling narratives that articulate long-term value and differentiation across opaque or less liquid investment vehicles, aligning with business priorities and product strategy.

- Drive monthly and quarterly product marketing updates, proactively reviewing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation to ensure consistency across all materials and channels.

- Analyze industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to recommend enhancements to marketing strategies, messaging, and campaigns.

- BA/BS required, concentration in marketing, finance, economics, communications, or related disciplines.

- 5+ years of private markets marketing or related financial services experience preferred.

- Deep understanding of private markets – especially private credit, including corporate private placements, infrastructure debt, and asset-based financing strategies – with the ability to translate complex strategies into compelling market narratives.

- Experience supporting intermediary and/or institutional distribution teams preferred.

- Familiarity with marketing restrictions and regulatory considerations specific to private offerings (e.g., Reg D, accredited investor rules) is a plus.

- Ability to support a range of product structures—including interval funds and other ’40 Act vehicles designed for semi-liquid strategies, as well as private vehicles such as CITs and LPs—with flexibility to adapt messaging and marketing strategies as new structures emerge.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects and execute multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.

- Ability to think strategically while also executing tactically and managing day-to-day deliverables.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills with keen attention to detail.

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively across functions and build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders.

- Advanced PowerPoint and Microsoft Office skills required.

- Experience with SharePoint, Seismic, or similar marketing platforms preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Product Owner Weath Experience
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 94754

Location Designation:   HMO-NYC Hybrid

Product Owner, Wealth Experience (PF4)

This position is based in HMO-New York City and is a Hybrid schedule.

Role Overview

We’re seeking a Product Owner to support the design and delivery of the wealth experience within NYL360. NYL360 is New York Life’s connected digital experience for the field, bringing together the tools, information, and insights advisors use every day in one place. Today, wealth products, tools, and processes often take a back seat to life insurance within the advisor experience — and the current environment is complex to navigate. You will own the effort to change that: ensuring wealth is prominently represented, thoughtfully designed, and easy to understand within the platform, in direct support of New York Life’s goal of Protection Powered Growth. You will work closely with other Product Owners, Designers, Engineers, data teams, testing teams, and field stakeholders to turn advisor wealth needs into well-defined, deliverable features. This is a fast-moving transformation effort, and what the team builds will fundamentally change how advisors sell, service, and manage wealth business every day.

What You’ll Do

Shape the Work Through Prototypes

- Partner with Design to turn high-level epics into working prototypes in place of traditional requirements documentation.

- Define & codify “what good looks like” for wealth products and tools — advisor needs, business rules, data requirements, and access — with an eye toward simplifying a complex operating environment.

- Refine the stories that come out of the prototype into clear scope and acceptance criteria for engineering.

- Keep the backlog ready for weekly sprint planning.

Coordinate Across Business, Field & Technology Teams

- Work in partnership with Design, Engineering, Data & Testing teams with fewer handoffs than traditional delivery models.

- Work directly with advisors, wealth product partners, and other field stakeholders to validate workflows and gather feedback.

- Flag dependencies, risks, and open decisions early enough for the team to act — particularly where wealth processes intersect with legacy systems or life insurance workflows.

Keep Weekly Delivery Moving

- Participate in weekly sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives.

- Answer questions and close requirement gaps in the moment so development keeps moving on a one-week cycle.

- Use AI tools in your own product work. This team relies on them heavily in design and development.

- Track sprint commitments, follow-ups, and open items, and own closing them out.

- Capture decisions and trade-offs as they happen.

Support User Acceptance Testing & Quality

- Build test scenarios based on real advisor wealth workflows and business use cases.

- Validate delivered functionality in the QA environment, document defects, and confirm resolutions.

Support Readiness & the Field Feedback Loop

- Contribute to communications, demos, and release documentation for new wealth capabilities.

- Support pilots and phased releases, gather feedback, and translate it into product improvements.

- Sort feedback and production issues into usability concerns, defects, enhancements, and maintain backlog items.

What You’ll Bring

Experience & Skills

- Experience in product ownership, digital delivery, or a related role preferred.

- Strong ability to translate user feedback and operational pain points into a clear direction, and to carry it through delivery.

- Comfort working with cross-functional teams in a complex environment with legacy systems and evolving processes.

- Familiarity with Agile methodology and tools such as Jira preferred.

- Uses AI tools in day-to-day work and looks for ways to apply them across product, design, and delivery.

- Strong attention to detail around data accuracy, business rules, and role-based requirements.

- Understanding of wealth management products, processes, or the advisor/agent experience is a plus.

Mindset & Behaviors

- Bias for progress. Owns follow-ups, closes gaps, and finds a practical path forward when the answer is not obvious.

- Decisive. Comfortable making calls with the information available and adjusting as the product evolves.

- Collaborative. Co-creates and iterates with Product, Design, Technology, Data, and field partners.

- Open to a different way of working. Comfortable trading heavy documentation for short cycles and working prototypes.
